sentences.l2: 一个小男孩有一个红色的玩具车。
sentences.l1: A little boy has a red toy car.

sentences.l2: 他把玩具车放在一个长长的斜坡上。
sentences.l1: He puts the toy car on a long slope.

sentences.l2: 当他放开玩具车的时候，玩具车开始滚动。
sentences.l1: When he lets go of the toy car, the toy car starts to roll.

sentences.l2: 它滚得很快，速度越来越快。
sentences.l1: It rolls very fast, and its speed gets faster and faster.

sentences.l2: 玩具车从斜坡上滚下来，最后停在地上。
sentences.l1: The toy car rolls down from the slope and finally stops on the ground.
